# GitHub Copilot Instructions

Read [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) first — it is the canonical source for all project rules, the
mandatory plan → implement workflow, architecture-constraint loading, and the graphify
knowledge-graph rules. Then [`docs/workflow/INDEX.md`](../docs/workflow/INDEX.md) for the
step-by-step workflow docs.

## Copilot-specific delta

- Type **`/graphify`** in Copilot Chat to build or update the knowledge graph.
